promises.quote: The Welsh Government has set up a National Strategic Programme for Mental Health in May 2024. This is being led by the NHS Executive, our delivery function within NHS Wales. An immediate focus for the mental health programme was the establishment of a Mental Health Patient Safety Programme, which all health boards are actively engaged in. There are five workstreams within the patient safety programme which cover procedural, relational, environmental, psychological and discharge areas.
promises.summary: Launch mental health patient safety programme with five workstreams
